eligibility.summary: IHS contracted UIOs In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Opportunity Number: HHS-2027-IHS-UIHP2-0001 — Agency: Indian Health Service.
Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity HHS-2027-IHS-UIHP2-0001.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.

funded_activities.activity: Eligible activities supporting Urban Indian Health 4-in-1 Program: To support urban Indians in four program areas - immunization, health promotion & disease prevention, mental health, alcohol and substance abuse.
